scope.selection: One combined male + unisex Most popular prefix; no category quotas

native_prefix_check.source: User-provided Fragrantica Most popular screenshot with male and unisex selected
native_prefix_check.method: Manually matched the ten fully visible names, brands and positions to the provider prefix
native_prefix_check.limitation: The screenshot does not establish positions 11-500 or the gender label of each individual perfume.

historical_label_crosscheck.note: Historical labels corroborate categories; they do not verify current popularity.

limitations: Provider pagination and metadata have been audited; all 500 native Fragrantica positions have not been independently verified.
Marketing gender labels perfume categories, never voter demographics or perceived masculinity.
Popularity defines this research population and is not an overall quality score.
Alternatives come from one curated public secondary dataset, not an exhaustive scrape of every similarity neighbor.
The alternative source displays affiliate links; generated pros/cons and its proprietary ranking are excluded.
Similarity counts are provider-reported; high agreement does not establish identical formulation or head-to-head preference.
A higher aggregate rating is a screening signal, not proof of a better fragrance.
Paired ratings use the same acquisition type; search aggregates may lag and secondary snapshot rating dates are unknown.
Reported US price ranges have unverified bottle volumes and do not establish comparable local value.
Screening thresholds are research-allocation assumptions; no overall or female-preference ranking is published.
